Independence of reference point
The moment of a force is only defined with respect to a certain point
P
(it is said to be the "moment about
P
") and, in general, when
P
is changed, the moment changes. However, the moment (torque) of a
couple
is
independent
of the reference point
P
: Any point will give the same moment.

1
